mapper.select: SELECT tid, name, age, title, department FROM teacher
SELECT tid, name, age, title, department FROM teacher WHERE tid = #{tid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher (tid, name, age, title, department) VALUES ((SELECT COALESCE(MAX(tid), 0) + 1 FROM teacher tmp), #{name}, #{age}, #{title}, #{department})
mapper.update: UPDATE teacher SET name = #{name}, age = #{age}, title = #{title}, department = #{department} WHERE tid = #{tid}
